summary: Giving yourself an item with a Wind Burst enchantment level higher than 3, then hitting certain entities crashes the game
description: The bug Hitting certain entities (boats, end crystals, fireballs, players, minecarts, shulker bullets and wind charges) with an item enchanted with a Wind Burst level greater than 4 crashes the game. How to reproduce - Enter the following command in the chat: /give @s mace[minecraft:enchantments={levels:{ wind_burst :4}}] - Hit one of the mentioned entities with the mace (it will work with any item)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Enter Creative mode by typing `/gamemode creative`.
2. Give yourself a mace with Wind Burst level 4 using the command: `/give @s mace{Enchantments:[{id:"minecraft:wind_burst",lvl:4}]}`
3. Find one of the mentioned entities (boats, end crystals, fireballs, players, minecarts, shulker bullets, or wind charges).
4. Hit the entity with the enchanted mace.
5. Observe that the game crashes after hitting the entity.
Observed Behavior: When an item enchanted with a Wind Burst level greater than 4 is used to hit certain entities, such as boats, end crystals, fireballs, players, minecarts, shulker bullets, and wind charges, the game crashes. To reproduce this issue, enter the command `/give @s mace{Enchantments:[{id:"minecraft:wind_burst",lvl:4}]}` in the chat to obtain a mace with a Wind Burst enchantment level of 4 or higher. Then, simply hit one of the mentioned entities with the enchanted item. This bug occurs regardless of the specific type of item used, as long as it has the required enchantment level.
Expected Behavior: When an item enchanted with a Wind Burst level greater than 4 is used to hit entities such as boats, end crystals, fireballs, players, minecarts, shulker bullets, or wind charges, the game should not crash. Instead, the entity should be affected by the Wind Burst enchantment without any stability issues, allowing for normal gameplay to continue.
